name: dsh-plugin-atlas
description: Knowledge-territory map for DeepSeek Harness: session conversations grow into a living map of concept 'cities' clustered into discipline 'continents', with typed routes and user-built 'bridges' (small containers holding your own notes and cross-discipline cards). AI proposes adjacencies; you light the connection. Data flows over an in-memory Connection RPC channel and a local markdown vault, never the session log.
